annotations.title: Bulk update listing attributes (title, bullets, patches)

description: Bulk listing attribute updates (title, bullet_point, any patch). updates: [{sku, title?, bullets?: string[], patches?: [...], product_type?, validate_only?}]. product_type is optional: each SKU's product type is read from its listing (results[].product_type_used). Use when you need to update titles or bullets on multiple SKUs at once instead of calling update_listing one by one. Returns {total, ok, errors, results[]}. SAFETY: show preview and require confirm before sending.

account_id.description: ID dell'outpost Amazon (= un seller su uno specifico marketplace; vedi list_clients). Opzionale se il token è legato a un solo outpost.

confirm_id.description: Token di conferma ritornato dall'anteprima. Ripassa lo STESSO payload + confirm_id per eseguire davvero la scrittura.

name: bulk_update_listings
